verdict.rationale: AFK's docs describe AI decomposing goals into tasks, revenue modeling, cohort analysis, KPI alerts and milestone tracking, which are AI-generated insights/suggestions surfaced inside the workspace. However this is entirely vendor-claimed marketing copy with no screenshots, hands-on demos, or independent corroboration of actual insight quality or UI presentation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification, concrete examples of generated insights, UI evidence of how suggestions are surfaced to users.
